verdict.rationale: Canva's official MCP server, built for AI assistants, documents design export in multiple production formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) and resizing for different channels, which gives an agent a documented programmatic render/export surface. The Connect APIs add a separate integration surface, though its export capability isn't spelled out here. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that exports work via the agent surface, detailed endpoint-level export documentation (e.g. Connect API export jobs), explicit screenshot/preview rendering.
